summary: Test-plan coverage was added for the OpenAPI migration, but Swift is not installed in this container and implementation is deferred to the following run.

references.result: Implementation must add Swift OpenAPI dependencies and vendor or fetch the published document.
Local-stub coverage exists for five existing flows; ranked-results coverage awaits the generated facade.
Requires source inspection after generated types replace handwritten transport models.
Tests use MockURLProtocol and require no live server; they could not execute because swift is unavailable.
Contract deltas are recorded for transfer to the implementation PR description.
